about: One entry per merged PR that names a scorecard number it should move (#1106). Add your PR's entry in the same PR. metric: a pipeline_scoreboard_snapshots column (coverage_rate, depth_live_institutions, ...) or a path into its detail (detail.goal.accuracy.accuracy, detail.goal.wrongAfterPublish.rate, detail.goal.liveInstitutions.live). direction: up or down. min_change: the smallest change that counts (same unit as the metric), optional.
